The American Academy of Ophthalmology recommends the following eye exam schedule:

- Adults 18-39 years old: Every 5-10 years if no vision problems or risk factors
- Adults 40-54 years old: Every 2-4 years if no vision problems or risk factors
- Adults 55-64 years old: Every 1-3 years if no vision problems or risk factors
- Adults 65 years and older: Every 1-2 years

However, if you have a family history of eye disease, diabetes, or other health conditions that may affect your vision, you may need to get your eyes examined more frequently. It's best to consult with an eye care professional for a personalized recommendation.
